figures.caption: The modern AI pipeline: base model to deployed agent
figures.source: Roitman, Hitchhiker's Guide to Agentic AI, Fig. 1, p.33
whatToNotice: Each stage maps to a Part of the guide: architecture, training, alignment, reasoning, then agentic.
A model is built up in stages; nothing about an agent appears until the foundation is in place.

figures.caption: The decoder-only Transformer block (GPT-style, Pre-Norm)
figures.source: Roitman, Hitchhiker's Guide to Agentic AI, Fig. 1.3, p.40
whatToNotice: Pre-Norm: the normalizer runs before each sub-layer, then a residual adds the input back, which is what lets the stack train without warmup.
Two residual paths (the dashed lines) carry the signal around attention and around the feed-forward network, forming the residual stream.
The whole block is repeated L times, then a final norm and a linear head turn the last hidden state into vocabulary scores.

figures.caption: A Mixture-of-Experts layer: a router sends each token to the top 2 of 8 experts
figures.source: Roitman, Hitchhiker's Guide to Agentic AI, Fig. 1.11, p.79
whatToNotice: The router scores all 8 experts but only the top 2 actually run, so most of the network stays idle for any given token.
Capacity grows with the number of experts, while the compute per token stays fixed.
